resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Greek source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, route checks, and generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Greek pass identified 25 remaining circuit, Joule-heating, TCR, trigonometry, thermal, SI, and wire-gauge wording issues; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Greek human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The voltage definition omitted the natural Greek article.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘Το V είναι τάση’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Το V είναι η τάση’.

findings.summary: The power explanation used θερμική χωρητικότητα instead of the established θερμοχωρητικότητα term.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘θερμική χωρητικότητα’ for the component's heat capacity.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘θερμοχωρητικότητα’ and clarified the safety margin for removing heat.

findings.summary: The constant-resistance relationship used a less direct production phrase.
evidence: The previous bullet said doubling current ‘παράγει’ four times the thermal power.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the direct relation ‘τετραπλασιάζει τη θερμική ισχύ’.

findings.summary: The constant-current relationship used an inconsistent θερμαντική ισχύ term.
evidence: The previous bullet used ‘θερμαντική ισχύ’.
findings.resolution: Standardized it on ‘θερμική ισχύ’.

findings.summary: The constant-voltage relationship used a less precise phrase for heat power.
evidence: The previous bullet described ‘ισχύ θέρμανσης’ rather than the shared technical term.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘θερμική ισχύ’.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating explanation used a less direct sentence structure for surface heat loss.
evidence: The previous paragraph used a long literal clause around energy leaving the surface.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with clear energy-rate, heat-capacity, and heat-flux-density terminology.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph used an incomplete phrase for the required margin.
evidence: The previous paragraph said ‘Χρησιμοποιήστε επαρκές περιθώριο’ without specifying safety.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘περιθώριο ασφαλείας’ and retained the component and battery limits.

findings.summary: The node definition used παρέμβαση rather than an explicit intermediate component.
evidence: The previous bullet ended ‘χωρίς παρέμβαση’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘χωρίς ενδιάμεσο εξάρτημα’.

findings.summary: The series-cell capacity statement used an overly literal equality phrase.
evidence: The previous bullet said capacity remained ‘ίση με εκείνη μιας κυψέλης’.
findings.resolution: Clarified that ampere-hour capacity remains approximately equal to one cell's capacity.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell statement used a literal προστίθενται construction.
evidence: The previous bullet said capacity and current ‘προστίθενται κατά προσέγγιση’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer ‘αθροίζονται περίπου’.

findings.summary: The current-distribution sentence used κοινή χρήση ρεύματος, which was ambiguous.
evidence: The previous bullet began ‘Η κοινή χρήση ρεύματος’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the technical term ‘Η κατανομή του ρεύματος’.

findings.summary: The circuit-solving title did not emphasize analysis of real circuits.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Επίλυση πραγματικών κυκλωμάτων’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Ανάλυση πραγματικών κυκλωμάτων’.

findings.summary: The TCR limitation paragraph used the literal term κλίσεις θερμοκρασίας without clear technical context.
evidence: The previous paragraph listed ‘κλίσεις θερμοκρασίας’ in a less natural sequence.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with ‘θερμοκρασιακές κλίσεις’ and clearer first-order-estimate wording.

findings.summary: The temperature-scale instruction repeated μονάδες ambiguously.
evidence: The previous bullet did not explicitly repeat that the same units are required.
findings.resolution: Changed it to explicitly require the same scale and units for T - T_0.

findings.summary: The angular-frequency bullet used μετριέται instead of a direct unit expression.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘μετριέται σε ακτίνια ανά δευτερόλεπτο’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘εκφράζεται σε ακτίνια ανά δευτερόλεπτο’.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating title used a longer phrase than the surrounding technical headings.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Θέρμανση με ηλεκτρικό ρεύμα’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the concise title ‘Ηλεκτρική θέρμανση’.

findings.summary: The area-conversion instruction used an inconsistent article and unit phrase.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘Μετατρέψτε το εμβαδόν ... το W/m²’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the smoother instruction ‘Μετατρέψτε το εμβαδόν ... χρησιμοποιήσετε το W/m²’.

findings.summary: The heat-loss checklist used singular απώλεια despite listing multiple mechanisms.
evidence: The previous bullet ended with ‘απώλεια θερμότητας’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘απώλειες θερμότητας’.

findings.summary: The conductivity definition needed consistent article usage.
evidence: The previous bullet used an unintroduced θερμική αγωγιμότητα noun phrase.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘k είναι η θερμική αγωγιμότητα’.

findings.summary: The layer temperature-difference definition did not identify the two sides.
evidence: The previous bullet only said ‘σε όλο το στρώμα’.
findings.resolution: Clarified it as the difference between the two sides of the layer.

findings.summary: The kelvin unit name remained in English in the SI table.
evidence: The previous table cell was ‘kelvin’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Greek unit name ‘κέλβιν’.

findings.summary: The pound-mass conversion localized the protected engineering units into prose.
evidence: The previous bullet used ‘1 λίβρα ... kg’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the unambiguous engineering notation ‘1 lb ≈ 0,45359237 kg’.

findings.summary: The nominal-diameter instruction used μπερδευτούν, which was informal and ambiguous.
evidence: The previous bullet said systems might ‘μπερδευτούν’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the technical verb ‘συγχέονται’.

findings.summary: The conductor-dimension instruction used uninflected engineering noun phrases.
evidence: The previous bullet listed ‘γυμνός αγωγός, μονωμένη διάμετρος’ without consistent case.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with consistent Greek case for bare conductor, insulated diameter, sheet thickness, and pipe-wall thickness.

findings.summary: The layer-thickness definition used a less natural word order.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘Το L είναι το πάχος του στρώματος σε μέτρα’ without a separating comma.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Το L είναι το πάχος του στρώματος, σε μέτρα’.
